headword: {紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}
reading: こうはくうたがっせん
gloss: NHK New Year's Eve music special

definitions.gloss: NHK Kōhaku Uta Gassen; annual New Year's Eve singing competition on NHK
definitions.explanation: Japan's most-watched annual TV broadcast, airing on NHK every New Year's Eve (December 31). Popular singers are divided into two teams — Red (female artists) and White (male artists) — who compete in performances judged by audience and panel. A cultural milestone since 1951.

examples.japanese: {紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}を{家族|かぞく}で{見|み}た。
examples.english: We watched the Kōhaku with the family.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}の{夜|よる}はNHKの{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}が{恒例|こうれい}だ。
examples.english: Watching NHK's Kōhaku on New Year's Eve is a tradition.

examples.japanese: {紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}に{出場|しゅつじょう}するのは、{歌手|かしゅ}にとって{名誉|めいよ}なことだと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that appearing on the Kōhaku is an honor for singers.

notes:
The full name is NHK{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}; commonly called simply {紅白|こうはく} in conversation. First broadcast in 1951, it remains one of Japan's highest-rated television programs.

{紅組|あかぐみ} (Red team) features female artists; {白組|しろぐみ} (White team) features male artists. Which team wins is decided by audience vote and an on-site panel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紅白|こうはく}を{見|み}る: to watch the Kōhaku
- {紅白|こうはく}に{出場|しゅつじょう}する: to appear on the Kōhaku
- {紅組|あかぐみ}/{白組|しろぐみ}: Red team / White team
